details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory.py:cmd_validation_history_append lines 1126-1138, cmd_operator_bypass_audit_append lines 1258-1269, cmd_revalidate_events_append lines 1382-1399 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new append commands treat MemoryGitError as a hard failure instead of the file's fail-open path.
  WHY: Five reviewers flag ok:false/exit 2 on transient git failures; qwen_qwen3_6-plus disputes this as matching the existing pattern.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: _normalize_validation_history_payload lines 817-848, and same pattern in _normalize_operator_bypass_audit_payload and _normalize_revalidate_events_payload | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The payload normalizers re-sort the full entries array on every append without a stable tie-breaker.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers report that equal-timestamp records can reorder across appends, breaking deterministic append-only semantics; qwen_qwen3_6-plus disputes the instability concern.
- scripts/ai_memory.py:cmd_validation_history_get lines 1015-1035, cmd_operator_bypass_audit_get lines 1070-1090, cmd_revalidate_events_get lines 1135-1155 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The get commands return the same hit:false shape for missing data and corrupt-but-recovered data.
  WHY: Callers cannot machine-distinguish absence from fail-open recovery, which can mislead downstream poller decisions.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: _validation_history_path (~615), _operator_bypass_audit_path (~630), _revalidate_events_path (~650), _normalize_repository_name (~584), _validate_integration_sha (~590) | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The path construction helpers do not fully validate repository/SHA inputs before filesystem writes.
  WHY: Reviewers report traversal/excessive-nesting risk from path construction before full hygiene checks; qwen_qwen3_6-plus disputes that the existing normalization chain leaves this open.
- scripts/ai_memory.py:cmd_validation_history_get, cmd_validation_history_append, cmd_operator_bypass_audit_get (~1010-1160) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Error messages are sanitized inconsistently across handlers.
  WHY: Some paths use str(exc) while others use _sanitize_git_error(str(exc)), producing different warning text and exposure levels.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: All new memory wrappers (~170-280) | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The wrappers swallow every non-zero exit from ai_memory.py and emit generic fail-open JSON.
  WHY: Persistent git lock/permission failures are treated the same as transient ones, so the orchestrator cannot tell when critical events were not recorded.
- scripts/ai_memory.py: cmd_validation_history_append (~1045), cmd_operator_bypass_audit_append (~1185), cmd_revalidate_events_append (~1320) | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The append commands accept entry files without early size, permission, or origin checks.
  WHY: Large or malicious entry files can drive unnecessary memory use or bypass intended schema constraints before the fail-open path.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: New _normalize_*_payload helpers (~780-900) | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The normalizers mutate input dicts in-place and unconditionally add schema_version.
  WHY: That can create schema validation mismatches for previously persisted records and make added validate_* calls reject older payload shapes.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: New constants VALIDATION_HISTORY_SCHEMA_VERSION, OPERATOR_BYPASS_AUDIT_SCHEMA_VERSION, REVALIDATE_EVENTS_SCHEMA_VERSION (~47-49) | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The new schema_version constants and normalization rules can reject older persisted records without the normalized shape.
  WHY: This breaks the repo's fail-open-on-load contract for pre-existing records and introduces backward-compatibility risk.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Follow the repo existing deterministic-artifact pattern (actions-runs-cache, fingerprint_quarantine, branch_rebuild_audit): explicit schema files, strict validation, normalized keys, and fail-open behavior on load/persist failures.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml minimum, plus the other workflow files that bootstrap schemas (orchestrate.yml, orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml, implement.yml, clarify.yml, plan.yml, review_autofix.yml)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: The three new schema files (validation_history.v1.json, operator_bypass_audit.v1.json, revalidate_events.v1.json) are NOT present in any workflow schema fetch loop; without them, _validate_with_schema_file will raise MemoryValidationError on every read/write.
- requirement: "Validation-history normalization re-sorts the full payload on every append, and the sort key is not stable enough for repeated equal-timestamp appends."
  expected_change_site: scripts/ai_memory_lib.py - _normalize_validation_history_payload (lines 824-838), _normalize_operator_bypass_audit_payload, _normalize_revalidate_events_payload
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  EVIDENCE: The sort key tuples include timestamp fields but lack a stable tiebreaker (like entry insertion order or a UUID). Two entries with identical timestamps can reorder across appends, breaking deterministic append-only semantics that downstream poller code will rely on.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/ai_memory.py:cmd_validation_history_append lines 1126-1138, cmd_operator_bypass_audit_append lines 1258-1269, cmd_revalidate_events_append lines 1382-1399 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The three new append commands catch MemoryGitError in a separate except block that returns ok:false and exit code 2.
  WHY: This diverges from the established fail-open pattern used by the existing put commands, so a transient git push failure can stop recording validation history, bypass audit, or revalidate events.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: _normalize_validation_history_payload lines 817-848, and same pattern in _normalize_operator_bypass_audit_payload and _normalize_revalidate_events_payload | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The payload normalizers re-sort the full entries array on every append.
  WHY: The sort key includes substantive fields, so same-second entries can reorder across appends and break append-only determinism.
- scripts/ai_memory.py:cmd_validation_history_get lines 1015-1035, cmd_operator_bypass_audit_get lines 1070-1090, cmd_revalidate_events_get lines 1135-1155 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Corrupt-but-recovered payloads return the same hit:false JSON shape as missing records.
  WHY: Poller code cannot distinguish never-run from recovered-corruption cases using machine-readable data.
- Requirement: Follow the repo existing deterministic-artifact pattern (actions-runs-cache, fingerprint_quarantine, branch_rebuild_audit): explicit schema files, strict validation, normalized keys, and fail-open behavior on load/persist failures.
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml minimum, plus the other workflow files that bootstrap schemas (orchestrate.yml, orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml, implement.yml, clarify.yml, plan.yml, review_autofix.yml)
  Evidence of absence: Every existing deterministic-artifact schema is included in at least one workflow schema fetch loop, but the three new schema files (validation_history.v1.json, operator_bypass_audit.v1.json, revalidate_events.v1.json) are NOT present in any of the eight workflow schema fetch loops.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
